texts.zh:
随着我们专注于净化我们的基因，我们正在认识到所有使我们文明伟大的事物。

当我们变得比以往任何时候都更加纯净，我们对我们优越的传承感到前所未有的自豪。

来自各个领域的专家；艺术界、科学界和商界，都在为我们的集体努力欢呼，并希望引领我们走向荣耀。
texts.en:
Complimenting the concentrated focus on purifying our genetics, we are realizing all the things that make our civilization great.

As we become purer than ever, we have never been more proud of our superior heritage.

Experts from all fields; the arts, science, and business, are all cheering on our collective efforts, and hoping to lead the way to our glory.

label.zh: 我们将通过资助艺术来庆祝这一里程碑！
label.en: We will celebrate this milestone by funding the arts!

label.zh: 科学研究必须永远放在首位。
label.en: Scientific research must always come first.
Consumption is the core of the economy.
